original.statement: The spec.otlp.translationStrategy field in monitoring.coreos.com/v1 Prometheus accepts a changed set of enum values; previously accepted values are now rejected by the API server, with UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes added.

corrected.statement: In the monitoring.coreos.com/v1 Prometheus CRD schema, the field spec.otlp.translationStrategy now also accepts the enum value UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes. No previously allowed value was removed, so values that were accepted before are still accepted.

decision.reason: The subject is right: validators confirmed the field exists in the Prometheus v1 schema in both CRD snapshots [ev-cc90e86e2643] [ev-c87966ce90d5]. The change type is wrong. The computed diff lists "removed []" and only adds "UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes", so no previously accepted value is now rejected. The crd-schema:tightened check also found no narrowing of the enum, required or type. "added" does not fit either, because the field already existed. The closest change type is behavior-changed: the field now also accepts the new value.
